_comment: M-PORT money-management config for _PortfolioRiskManager (specs/m-port-spec.md §5.1). Every field is optional: a missing field keeps its code default (shown here). Keys starting with '_' are comments. Unknown keys log a warning; a bad value logs a warning and keeps the default; a file that fails validation as a whole is ignored (code defaults).
_sizing: CodeSize (EntryContracts = -1, the strategy's own CS-4 size) | RiskParity (equal $ risk per entry) | VolTarget (equal share of book vol x IDM)
_bookVolTarget: VolTarget only: annualised book volatility target, (0, 5)
_riskPerTrade: RiskParity: book fraction risked per new entry at multiplier 1, (0, 1)
_heatCap: max (open risk + new risk) / book equity, (0, 1]
_clusterCap: max risk per correlation cluster / book equity, (0, 1] and <= heatCap
_rhoMerge: clusters merge when max(rho, stressed rho) >= rhoMerge, (0, 1]
_rhoWin: rolling correlation window in sessions, integer >= 3
_rhoMinDays: minimum common days for a correlation (falls back to underlying returns below), 3..rhoWin
_maxPositions: max concurrent open positions across the portfolio, integer >= 1
_ddSteps: drawdown-from-peak throttle: dd ascending in (0,1), mult non-increasing in [0,1]; mult 0 = entries off
_ddRecoverHighDays: throttle steps down at a new N-session equity high (or dd < half the step), integer >= 1
_dailyLossStop: book loss today / book at session open that blocks new entries for the session, (0, 1)
_dailyLossFlatten: book loss today that force-closes every open position; must be > dailyLossStop and < 1
_stratKillR: strategy kill: cumulative R over the last stratKillTrades trades <= this (negative) -> flatten, then pause
_stratKillTrades: trades in the kill window, integer >= 1
_staleBars: a publisher whose pm.stamp is older than its own bar staleBars back is denied entries, integer >= 1
_minContracts: below this size after scaling the entry is denied, integer >= 1
_idmCap: VolTarget: cap on the diversification multiplier, [1, 10]
